intro.data: The plain pipeline (at right) Cleans one record, then Charts it. The tray holds batch machines to lift the whole pipeline. Bring either two steps (Batch Cleaner, then Batch Charter) OR the single pre-lifted Batch Processor onto the board and wire a route to the batch of charts — both routes reach it, that's the point. Leave the impostor charter in the tray.
intro.alchemy: The plain pipeline (at right) Smelts one ore, then Shapes it. The tray holds crate apparatus to lift the whole pipeline. Bring either two steps (Crate Smelter, then Crate Shaper) OR the single pre-lifted Crate Forger onto the board and wire a route to the crate of tools — both routes reach it. Leave the impostor in the tray.
intro.spellcraft: The plain pipeline (at right) Kindles one spark, then Beacons it. The tray holds flock workings to lift the whole pipeline. Bring either two steps (Flock Kindler, then Flock Beaconer) OR the single pre-lifted Flock Conjurer onto the board and wire a route to the flock of beacons — both routes reach it. Leave the impostor in the tray.
intro.abstract: F(x) means the value x lifted into the batch world (the box holding x), and the lift F(f) does f to each item inside — so F(g∘f) = F(g)∘F(f). From the tray, bring either F(f) then F(g), or the single pre-lifted F(g∘f) (each F(2) ↦ F(6)), and wire F(A) to F(C); leave the impostor F(g)? (F(3) ↦ F(10)) behind.

goal.data: Bring batch machines from the tray and wire a batch of raw records to a batch of charts, by either route.
goal.alchemy: Bring crate apparatus from the tray and wire a crate of ore to a crate of tools, by either route.
goal.spellcraft: Bring flock workings from the tray and wire a flock of sparks to a flock of beacons, by either route.
goal.abstract: Bring lifts from the tray and wire F(A) to F(C), by either route.

description.data: the Cleaner run on a whole batch — cleans every record
description.alchemy: the Smelter run on a whole crate — refines every ore
description.spellcraft: the Kindler run on a whole flock — kindles every spark
description.abstract: the faithful lift of f: sends F(2) ↦ F(3) (does f to each item in the box)

description.data: the Charter run on a whole batch — charts every record
description.alchemy: the Shaper run on a whole crate — shapes every ingot
description.spellcraft: the Beaconer run on a whole flock — beacons every flame
description.abstract: the faithful lift of g: sends F(3) ↦ F(6) (does g to each item in the box)

description.data: the whole pipeline lifted as one — clean then chart, on a whole batch
description.alchemy: the whole process lifted as one — smelt then shape, on a whole crate
description.spellcraft: the whole working lifted as one — kindle then beacon, on a whole flock
description.abstract: the pre-lifted composite: sends F(2) ↦ F(6) (= F(g) ∘ F(f))

description.data: a DIFFERENT machine run on the batch — not the lift of the Charter
description.alchemy: a DIFFERENT apparatus run on the crate — not the lift of the Shaper
description.spellcraft: a DIFFERENT working run on the flock — not the lift of the Beaconer
description.abstract: sends F(3) ↦ F(10) — does NOT lift g (a same-typed impostor)

afterSuccess.data: Lifting each step (Batch Cleaner, then Batch Charter) and using the single pre-lifted machine (Batch Processor) both produced the same batch of charts. That's functoriality: F(g∘f) = F(g)∘F(f) — lifting a composite equals composing the lifts.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Lifting each step and using the pre-lifted whole both produced the same crate. F(g∘f) = F(g)∘F(f).
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Lifting each step and using the pre-lifted whole both produced the same flock. F(g∘f) = F(g)∘F(f).
afterSuccess.abstract: Both routes produced the same F(C): F(g∘f) = F(g)∘F(f).

reveal.summary: Functors preserve composition: lifting a whole pipeline equals lifting each step and composing — F(g ∘ f) = F(g) ∘ F(f).
reveal.moreFormal: With identity preservation, this is the full definition of a functor: it carries every commuting diagram in C to a commuting diagram in D.
